# ArchiveEntry

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Read-only metadata snapshot. Distinguishes files, directories, links, special and unknown entries.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#reading-archives-400).

## CompressedSize

`ArchiveEntry.CompressedSize: LONG`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only archive member metadata. Sizes are reported values, not trusted allocation limits; Index is zero-based.

## Date

`ArchiveEntry.Date: DATE`

Read-only instance property.

Native DATE or TIME from archive metadata, without an assumed timezone. Empty when unavailable.
